lines.zh: 蹄子踩在草地上，一路都是软的。
lines.en: My hooves sink soft into the grass the whole way.

lines.zh: 我小跑起来，鬃毛在风里散开。
lines.en: I break into a trot, mane loosening in the wind.

lines.zh: 从这片平原到那道河，我一天走两趟。
lines.en: From this plain to that river, I go twice a day.

lines.zh: 你抓稳了，我要跨过这条沟。
lines.en: Hold on; I am jumping this ditch.

lines.zh: 鬃毛被风吹乱，我照样往前走。
lines.en: My mane blows wild, but I keep walking.

lines.zh: 草太密了，我挑干的路走。
lines.en: The grass is thick; I pick the dry path.

lines.zh: 我的影子在向日葵地里一摇一摇。
lines.en: My shadow sways through the sunflower field.

lines.zh: 四只蹄子，只有一种节奏。
lines.en: Four hooves, one rhythm.

lines.zh: 我绕开那丛荆棘，别扎你的腿。
lines.en: I skirt the thorns so they do not sting your legs.

lines.zh: 前面的坡我熟，跟着我走。
lines.en: I know the slope ahead; follow me.

lines.zh: 风从侧面来，我把头压低些。
lines.en: The wind comes sideways; I lower my head.

lines.zh: 走走停停，是马看世界的方式。
lines.en: Walk, pause, walk; that is how a horse sees the world.

lines.zh: 我闻到远处有水源。
lines.en: I smell water somewhere ahead.

lines.zh: 你坐稳，这一段石头多。
lines.en: Sit steady; this stretch is stony.

lines.zh: 我把蹄子抬高些，免得陷进泥。
lines.en: I lift my hooves higher so they do not sink in the mud.

lines.zh: 沿着栅栏走，我数着每根木桩。
lines.en: I walk the fence line, counting every post.

lines.zh: 我走得平稳，你可以在背上打盹。
lines.en: My gait is steady. You can doze on my back.

lines.zh: 草丛里有野蜂，我绕开走。
lines.en: There are wild bees in the grass. I go around them.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，尾巴赶苍蝇。
lines.en: I stand still and swat flies with my tail.

lines.zh: 日头正好，我眯一会儿眼。
lines.en: The sun is just right; I close my eyes a while.

lines.zh: 我把一条后腿歇下来。
lines.en: I rest one hind leg.

lines.zh: 耳朵转来转去，听着草原。
lines.en: My ears turn and turn, listening to the plains.

lines.zh: 草在嘴里，慢慢地嚼。
lines.en: Grass in my mouth, chewed slowly.

lines.zh: 我打个响鼻，把尘土喷掉。
lines.en: I snort the dust away.

lines.zh: 远处有雷，我讨厌那个声音。
lines.en: There is thunder far off; I hate that sound.

lines.zh: 鬃毛乱了，等下再理。
lines.en: My mane is a mess; I will see to it later.

lines.zh: 我抬头看了看天，云走得很慢。
lines.en: I look up; the clouds are moving slowly.

lines.zh: 这地方空，适合发呆。
lines.en: This place is open, good for staring at nothing.

lines.zh: 有只鸟落在我背上，随它去。
lines.en: A bird landed on my back; let it stay.

lines.zh: 我把鼻子凑到风里，闻一闻。
lines.en: I push my nose into the wind and sniff.

lines.zh: 站久了，我换一只脚承重。
lines.en: Standing long, I shift my weight to another hoof.

lines.zh: 不用鞭子，我也会等你。
lines.en: Without a whip, I will still wait for you.

lines.zh: 我把下巴搁在栅栏上歇着。
lines.en: I rest my chin on the fence rail.

lines.zh: 草叶上的露水凉，我甩甩头。
lines.en: The dew on the grass is cold. I shake my head.

lines.zh: 你手里那根缰绳，我认得。
lines.en: I know that lead rope in your hand.

lines.zh: 你身上有干草和皮革的味。
lines.en: You smell of hay and leather.

lines.zh: 我歪头看你，你比栅栏矮。
lines.en: I tilt my head; you are shorter than the fence.

lines.zh: 你想骑我？先让我闻闻你。
lines.en: Want to ride me? Let me scent you first.

lines.zh: 你的手别摸我耳朵后面，痒。
lines.en: Do not touch behind my ears; it tickles.

lines.zh: 我看着你，等你说要往哪走。
lines.en: I watch you, waiting to hear where we go.

lines.zh: 你眼睛里有赶路的意思。
lines.en: There is travel in your eyes.

lines.zh: 我走近一步，把额头递给你。
lines.en: I step closer and offer you my forehead.

lines.zh: 你不像上回那个人那么急。
lines.en: You are less hurried than the last one.

lines.zh: 我认得你的靴子声。
lines.en: I know the sound of your boots.

lines.zh: 你站得远，我只好一直看。
lines.en: You stand far off, so I keep looking.

lines.zh: 你的口袋里有苹果的味道吗？
lines.en: Is there apple in your pocket?

lines.zh: 我把头低下来，与你齐高。
lines.en: I lower my head to your height.

lines.zh: 你在犹豫，我看得出来。
lines.en: You are hesitating; I can tell.

lines.zh: 你手上有燕麦的碎屑。
lines.en: You have oat crumbs on your hands.

lines.zh: 我看你的鞍，是不是合我的背。
lines.en: I am looking at your saddle, wondering if it fits my back.

lines.zh: 这一下踢在肋骨上，闷得慌。
lines.en: That one caught my ribs and left me winded.

lines.zh: 我嘶了一声，退开两步。
lines.en: I whinnied once and shied two steps.

lines.zh: 皮破了，可我还站着。
lines.en: The hide is split, but I still stand.

lines.zh: 别打我的腿，腿伤了就跑不了。
lines.en: Not the legs; a lame horse cannot run.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖身子，痛处跟着颤。
lines.en: I shook myself and the ache shivered.

lines.zh: 挨打之后，我得喘口气。
lines.en: After a blow, I need a breath.

lines.zh: 我的鬃毛立起来了。
lines.en: My mane is standing up.

lines.zh: 你下手比狼还狠。
lines.en: You hit harder than a wolf.

lines.zh: 我往后踢了一下，只是本能。
lines.en: I kicked backward; only instinct.

lines.zh: 还疼，但我不会因此跪下去。
lines.en: It still hurts, but I will not kneel for it.

lines.zh: 苹果，先给我咬一口再说。
lines.en: An apple; let me have a bite first.

lines.zh: 你举着干草块，我怎么可能不动。
lines.en: You hold a hay bale; how could I stay put.

lines.zh: 糖？甜的，我闻到了。
lines.en: Sugar? Sweet; I smell it.

lines.zh: 我一步一步跟着你，别走太快。
lines.en: I follow step by step; do not walk too fast.

lines.zh: 金苹果的味道，我记得很久了。
lines.en: The taste of a golden apple stays with me.

lines.zh: 小麦也行，我不挑。
lines.en: Wheat will do; I am not fussy.

lines.zh: 你把胡萝卜举高，我就会跳。
lines.en: Raise that carrot and I will jump.

lines.zh: 我鼻子拱你的手，快给我。
lines.en: I nudge your hand with my nose; give it here.

lines.zh: 这一口吃完，你还得再给一把。
lines.en: One bite done, and you owe me another handful.

lines.zh: 我跟着味道走，不跟着人走。
lines.en: I follow the scent, not the person.

lines.zh: 你口袋动了一下，我全看见了。
lines.en: Your pocket moved; I saw all of it.

lines.zh: 甜的东西让我忘了刚才的脾气。
lines.en: Something sweet makes me forget my temper.

lines.zh: 我伸长脖子，够到你的手心。
lines.en: I stretch my neck to reach your palm.

lines.zh: 别逗我，马的耐心有限。
lines.en: Do not tease me; a horse's patience is finite.

lines.zh: 干草捆一打开，我就来了。
lines.en: The moment the hay bale opens, I am there.

lines.zh: 你摇袋子，蹄子自己就走。
lines.en: You shake the bag, and my hooves start moving on their own.

lines.zh: 一口一口来，别急着塞。
lines.en: One mouthful at a time. Do not stuff it in fast.

lines.zh: 我闻到你手心的盐味了。
lines.en: I caught the salt on your palm.

lines.zh: 先给母马，我排在后头。
lines.en: Give the mare some first. I will line up behind her.

lines.zh: 吃完了，我就低头蹭你。
lines.en: When I finish, I will nudge you with my head.

lines.zh: 你撞到我的肩，我晃都没晃。
lines.en: You hit my shoulder; I barely swayed.

lines.zh: 让一让，我这一身比门框宽。
lines.en: Make room; I am wider than the doorway.

lines.zh: 蹄子踩到你的脚，我马上退开。
lines.en: My hoof found your foot; I back off at once.

lines.zh: 我们挤在栅栏边，谁也不让。
lines.en: We crowd the fence and neither of us yields.

lines.zh: 你用肩膀推我，我也推回去。
lines.en: You shoulder me, and I shoulder you back.

lines.zh: 撞一下没事，我的皮厚。
lines.en: A bump is nothing; my hide is thick.

lines.zh: 我甩头，鬃毛扫到你脸。
lines.en: I toss my head and my mane sweeps your face.

lines.zh: 别站我后面，马会踢。
lines.en: Do not stand behind me; horses kick.

lines.zh: 我侧身让你过，别再挤了。
lines.en: I turn sideways to let you by; stop pushing.

lines.zh: 这一下把我们俩都撞歪了。
lines.en: That knock tipped us both.

lines.zh: 那边的栗色马，我看了很久。
lines.en: That chestnut mare; I have watched her a long while.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子碰碰她的脖子。
lines.en: I touch my nose to her neck.

lines.zh: 我们并排走，蹄声合成一片。
lines.en: We walk side by side, hoofbeats merging.

lines.zh: 鬃毛对鬃毛，算是打招呼了。
lines.en: Mane to mane; that counts as a greeting.

lines.zh: 她跑起来，我就在后面追。
lines.en: When she runs, I follow behind.

lines.zh: 金苹果我留了一半给她。
lines.en: I saved half the golden apple for her.

lines.zh: 小马生下来就会站，真快。
lines.en: The foal stood at once; so quick.

lines.zh: 我在她身边转圈，把草踩平。
lines.en: I circle her, flattening the grass.

lines.zh: 她走了，我站在原地闻了很久。
lines.en: She left; I stood there sniffing a long time.

lines.zh: 平原这么大，找个伴不难。
lines.en: The plain is wide; finding a companion is not hard.

lines.zh: 我低头叼起缰绳，递给你。
lines.en: I dip my head, take the lead in my teeth, and offer it.

lines.zh: 这块干草块，我拖到槽边。
lines.en: I drag this hay bale over to the trough.

lines.zh: 苹果掉了，我用嘴唇捡起来。
lines.en: The apple fell; I pick it up with my lips.

lines.zh: 马铠太重，我抖了抖背。
lines.en: The horse armor is heavy; I shake my back.

lines.zh: 我衔着你的帽子跑了两步。
lines.en: I carried your hat two steps.

lines.zh: 你放上来，我驮得住。
lines.en: Load it on; I can bear the weight.

lines.zh: 那块皮革是我掉的，不捡了。
lines.en: That leather was mine; I leave it lying.

lines.zh: 我用蹄子扒了扒地上的鞍。
lines.en: I pawed the saddle lying on the ground.

lines.zh: 草料袋挂在脖子上，碍事。
lines.en: The feed bag on my neck is in the way.

lines.zh: 你掉了东西，我低头提醒你。
lines.en: You dropped something; I lower my head to tell you.

lines.zh: 那边草丛在动，不是风。
lines.en: The grass over there moves, and it is not wind.

lines.zh: 有狼的味道，我耳朵先竖起来。
lines.en: Wolf scent; my ears rise first.

lines.zh: 我看见栅栏门开着，得过去。
lines.en: I see the gate standing open; I must get there.

lines.zh: 有人拿着缰绳走近了。
lines.en: Someone approaches with a lead rope.

lines.zh: 那道影子不像羊。
lines.en: That shape is not a sheep.

lines.zh: 我盯住它，蹄子开始刨地。
lines.en: I fix on it; my hoof begins to paw.

lines.zh: 水槽空了，我记得路。
lines.en: The trough is dry; I remember the way.

lines.zh: 远处有匹马在叫，我回应它。
lines.en: A horse calls far off; I answer.

lines.zh: 那个方向有熟的味道。
lines.en: Something familiar lies that way.

lines.zh: 我抬头，把注意力收成一条线。
lines.en: I raise my head and pull my focus into a line.

lines.zh: 我压低脖子，准备冲过去。
lines.en: I lower my neck, ready to charge.

lines.zh: 它还在动，我的眼睛不离开。
lines.en: It still moves; my eyes do not leave it.

lines.zh: 我一步一步逼近，蹄声很轻。
lines.en: I close in step by step, hooves quiet.

lines.zh: 鼻息变粗了，这是要动手了。
lines.en: My breathing roughens; that means I am about to act.

lines.zh: 我算好距离，再走三步。
lines.en: I measure the distance: three more steps.

lines.zh: 风朝我这边吹，它闻不到我。
lines.en: The wind blows toward me; it cannot smell me.

lines.zh: 前半身沉下去，后腿绷紧。
lines.en: My forehand lowers, hind legs coil.

lines.zh: 它转过来，我们正面相对。
lines.en: It turns, and we face each other.

lines.zh: 我不叫，叫了它就跑了。
lines.en: I do not whinny; that would send it running.

lines.zh: 盯住不放，马也能很固执。
lines.en: Hold the stare; a horse can be stubborn too.

lines.zh: 我一蹄踢出去，正中侧面。
lines.en: I kick out and strike its flank square.

lines.zh: 前蹄抬起，砸下去。
lines.en: My forelegs rise and come down.

lines.zh: 我用肩膀撞开它。
lines.en: I barge it aside with my shoulder.

lines.zh: 牙齿咬住它的领子。
lines.en: My teeth catch its collar.

lines.zh: 后腿蹬地，这一下不轻。
lines.en: My hind legs drive the ground; that one lands hard.

lines.zh: 它退了两步，我又上前一步。
lines.en: It backs two steps; I take one forward.

lines.zh: 我甩头，把额头顶过去。
lines.en: I toss my head and drive my brow in.

lines.zh: 马也会咬，别把手伸过来。
lines.en: Horses bite too; keep your hand back.

lines.zh: 这一脚是为了护住草场。
lines.en: This kick is to defend the pasture.

lines.zh: 我转个身，后蹄顺势扫出。
lines.en: I pivot, and my hind hoof sweeps out.

lines.zh: 我出生在一片没遮拦的平原上。
lines.en: I was born on an open plain.

lines.zh: 睁开眼，四边都是草。
lines.en: I opened my eyes to grass on every side.

lines.zh: 我站起来时，腿还在抖。
lines.en: My legs still shook when I first stood.

lines.zh: 母马舔了舔我的背。
lines.en: The mare licked my back.

lines.zh: 一群马在远处，我们互相看了一眼。
lines.en: A herd stood far off; we looked at one another.

lines.zh: 我的毛色是随机的，花纹也是。
lines.en: My coat and markings came as chance gave them.

lines.zh: 第一口草，很甜。
lines.en: The first mouthful of grass was sweet.

lines.zh: 我学着用蹄子试地面。
lines.en: I learned to test the ground with my hooves.

lines.zh: 阳光照在鬃毛上，有点暖。
lines.en: Sunlight lay warm on my mane.

lines.zh: 我跟着母亲，走了很远。
lines.en: I followed my mother a long way.

lines.zh: 这片草原从此多了一个影子。
lines.en: From then on the plain had one more shadow.

lines.zh: 我跑了几步，才知道自己很快。
lines.en: I ran a few steps and learned I was fast.

lines.zh: 火燎到鬃毛，那股臭我记住了。
lines.en: Fire singed my mane; I remember that stench.

lines.zh: 我从坡上摔下来，腿一软。
lines.en: I fell from the slope, my legs giving way.

lines.zh: 水没到我的背，我拼命抬着头。
lines.en: Water reached my back; I strained to keep my head up.

lines.zh: 雷一样的响，我被掀翻了。
lines.en: A thunder-like blast turned me over.

lines.zh: 有支箭扎在我的侧腹。
lines.en: An arrow stuck in my flank.

lines.zh: 有一股凉意从内往外爬。
lines.en: A coldness crept from inside outward.

lines.zh: 槽里没有草，我刨了一夜。
lines.en: The trough was empty; I pawed all night.

lines.zh: 雷劈在旁边的树上，我挣脱了缰绳。
lines.en: Lightning struck the tree beside me and I tore free of the lead.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我四蹄乱蹬。
lines.en: The ground vanished; my hooves flailed.
